title: Valuation probe at a closure point of a quasi-compact immersion
statement: Let j:Z\to S be a quasi-compact immersion of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For every point s\in\operatorname{closure}(j(Z)) there exist a valuation ring A with fraction field K, a morphism g:\operatorname{Spec}(A)\to S, and a morphism h:\operatorname{Spec}(K)\to Z such that g|_{\operatorname{Spec}(K)}=h followed by j and the closed point of \operatorname{Spec}(A) maps to s.

mathlib_searches.query: for a point in the closure of the image of a quasi-compact morphism there exists a valuation ring whose generic point maps into the source
